skill_name: Given a quotation, present an argument as to why it is relevant today.
workflow: In today's society, people are often judged by their ability to perform certain tasks rather than the unique skills and strengths they possess. This quote from Albert Einstein serves as a reminder to us not to limit ourselves and others by what we think is possible. It also serves as a reminder to appreciate the potential and greatness which exists in each person, regardless of how they express it.
